anti_rescue: only R5_POSITIVE_RUNTIME_IMPROVEMENT may be described as an improvement; every other label is reported as a negative or uninterpretable outcome, never as a partial success
no secondary endpoint, subset, prompt, budget, thread count or tracing configuration can upgrade the classification
no second scheduler variant, no parameter, no new prompt and no new budget after the freeze
the oracle bound H is never reported as an achievable gain
the evaluation is opened once; reruns only under blame_rules
no optional stopping: block counts are constants of this contract
no outlier removal, imputation, reordering or data-driven exclusion

infrastructure_causes: loss of AC power or host shutdown/reboot documented in the Windows event log
forced Windows Update or Defender scan documented in the event log
disk full on the system drive
manual interruption by the operator, recorded before the launch result is read
blame_rules.reruns: a slot failed for an infrastructure cause may be rerun once (attempt+1); a correctness failure of C/C_I/C0_I (token digest, budget, pending reads, abort) is never rerun; a second failure of the same slot aborts the campaign
blame_rules.rule: A failed or invalid launch of C, C_I or C0_I is attributed to the intervention unless it matches a pre-listed infrastructure cause with documentary evidence; a failed or invalid launch of A or B is attributed to the campaign.
blame_rules.terminal: R5_INVALID is final: the evaluation is not reopened, no new campaign is started under this contract

classification_order: G1 fails (Phase 1a), or any Phase 2 launch of C, C_I or C0_I has a correctness failure or a non-infrastructure failure
Phase 2 campaign aborted or integrity failure of A/B launches
G3 and G4 and G5 and G6
G3 and G4 and not (G5 and G6)

gates.G1_implementation: Phase 1a delivers C and C0 with: identical tokens to A on all four development prompts at 1.5 and 4 GiB; 0 budget violations; 0 pending reads at graph end; 0 redundant transfers; the frozen issue order (model-free test); scheduling purity within 1% on development prompts; model-free store tests passing; all mechanism metrics computable; baseline fidelity: A on the R5 build produces tokens identical to the pre-R5 runtime (llama-research-v5) on the development prompts and its mean decode ms/token is not more than 2% slower (point estimate over 4 prompts x 2 launches each). Otherwise R5_IMPLEMENTATION_OR_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED.
gates.G2_headroom: one-shot: H from the 8 pre-declared B launches on the frozen binary >= 0.04. Otherwise R5_NO_MEANINGFUL_OVERLAP_HEADROOM and the evaluation is never opened. H is not recomputed.
gates.G3_primary: 95% lower bound of the primary aggregate >= 0.02
gates.G4_mechanism: mechanism campaign (12 blocks, df = 11): (a) 95% upper bound of the mean block difference exposed_wait_ms_per_token(C_I) - exposed_wait_ms_per_token(C0_I) < 0; (b) mean hidden_deferred_bytes_fraction(C_I) >= 0.25; (c) mean[exposed_wait(C0_I) - exposed_wait(C_I)] >= 0.5 x mean[exposed_store(B) - exposed_store(C_I)] whenever the latter is positive
gates.G5_no_harm: 4 GiB: 95% upper bound of the mean block relative slowdown (-r_b) <= 0.02
gates.G6_consistency: at least 3 of the 4 evaluation prompts have a positive mean r_b at 1.5 GiB
gates.G7_purity: in the mechanism campaign (C_I vs B) and in both timing campaigns (C vs A, end-of-run counters): relative difference of mean miss bytes per token and of mean evictions per token <= 0.01; budget violations 0
gates.IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE: before G2: source hashes, binary hash, model and store hashes, and the list of implementation choices (wait primitive, handle-release point, barrier placement, pin-release point, touch order, trace record layout) are frozen; no change afterwards; every development timing comparison run before the freeze is appended to a committed development log
gates.INTEGRITY: every counted launch: 512 decode tokens; token digest equal to the digest of that prompt in every other arm; runtime, model and store hashes equal to the implementation freeze; no abort; server timings present; end-of-run counter record present; ARGINE_EXPERT_WAIT echoed as expected; AC power

hopi_gate: HoPi M9+ stays paused unless the classification is R5_POSITIVE_RUNTIME_IMPROVEMENT. Every other label, including a clean negative, does not unlock HoPi; it requires the next Argine direction to be identified.

label_meaning.R5_CONFOUNDED_NOT_PURE_SCHEDULING: C changed residency beyond tolerance: no attribution possible
label_meaning.R5_IMPLEMENTATION_OR_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED: the deferred wait cannot be implemented correctly, stably or measurably in this runtime
label_meaning.R5_INVALID: the campaign cannot be interpreted; final
label_meaning.R5_MECHANISM_PRESENT_BUT_NO_NET_RUNTIME_: stall was hidden but end-to-end decode did not improve by the MEI: falsifies the runtime hypothesis
label_meaning.R5_NO_MEANINGFUL_OVERLAP_HEADROOM: not enough hideable transfer latency on the critical path: the direction is closed before evaluation
label_meaning.R5_NO_REALISED_OVERLAP_NO_GAIN: headroom existed in the bound but the implementation did not hide stall: falsifies the mechanism hypothesis
label_meaning.R5_POSITIVE_RUNTIME_IMPROVEMENT: the only outcome that counts as a demonstrated real-runtime improvement (and the only one that can unlock HoPi)
label_meaning.R5_PRIMARY_GAIN_NOT_ROBUST: faster at 1.5 GiB but harmful at 4 GiB or not consistent across prompts: not an improvement
label_meaning.R5_RUNTIME_CHANGE_WITHOUT_MECHANISM: a timing change that the deferred-wait mechanism does not explain (for example cheaper bookkeeping): not attributed to the R5 hypothesis, not an improvement

precision_plan.note: planning only; normal approximation with the t critical value; no R5 data are used
precision_plan.risk_statement: The reference SD comes from the Research 3 blocco path (about 527 ms/token); the asincrono path is faster and its relative SD may be larger. If so, power falls; block counts are nevertheless fixed now and are not changed after any R5 data exist. A development A-vs-A noise estimate is reported in Phase 1 for information only.

threshold_justification.H_gate_4pct: twice the MEI; realised hiding is a fraction of this optimistic bound, so below 4% there is no realistic way to pass the primary gate. Failing it only closes the direction early.
threshold_justification.MEI_2pct: practical relevance plus measurement scale: a decode-time reduction below 2% would not justify carrying a runtime change, and 2% is the frozen instrumentation-cost scale of EXP-024; it is about twice the expected 95% half-width of the paired primary interval (precision_plan)
threshold_justification.attribution_50pct: at least half of the reduction of time inside the store hook must come from waiting less, not from cheaper bookkeeping
threshold_justification.hidden_floor_25pct: a mechanism in which fewer than a quarter of the deferred bytes arrive before they are needed is not a meaningful overlap
threshold_justification.no_harm_2pct: the same practical scale as the MEI: C must not trade a gain at 1.5 GiB for a loss of comparable size where misses are rarer; with 20 blocks a harmless C passes with high probability (precision_plan)
threshold_justification.purity_1pct: C must be a scheduling change; a larger change in miss bytes or evictions would mean residency changed and the effect could not be attributed to overlap
